name: Polycab India Ltd
about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

flags.text: Profits are real: 101% of 5-yr profit converted to operating cash

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Capital expenditure for the quarter was ₹ 3.4 billion, taking the 9M FY26 total to ₹ 10.9 billion, in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
items.evidence: The annual capex guidance through FY30 is pending as the horizon has not been reached.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are confident in the long-term potential of the FMEG segment and remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
items.evidence: The FY30 FMEG EBITDA margin target is pending as the horizon has not been reached.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.
items.evidence: The EPC operating margin target for the mid- to long-term is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.
items.evidence: The working capital cycle target of 50 to 55 days is pending as it refers to coming quarters.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: every year going ahead now, we believe that FMEG will continue to improve its profitability towards the guided range of 8% to 10% by FY30.
items.evidence: The FY30 FMEG profitability target is pending.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: every year going ahead, we can definitely see an improvement or increase in our investments towards A&P. But it will be difficult to say that this will be every year or every quarter run rate... we want to take A&P spends up to 3% to 5% of B2C top-line
items.evidence: The A&P spend target of 3% to 5% of B2C top-line is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%.
items.evidence: The long-term Cables and Wires EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
items.evidence: The 5-year capex program is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
items.evidence: The FY2030 export contribution target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We are well aligned with our Project Spring objectives of delivering 1.5x to 2x of industry growth while steadily improving our margins.
items.evidence: The Project Spring revenue growth target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.
items.evidence: The FY2030 FMEG EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
items.target: 11% to 13% (long term); 12% to 14% (near to mid term)
items.evidence: The near to mid-term EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year. And in FY28 revenues, we can see some contribution from EHV capacity
items.evidence: The EHV capacity commissioning target was moved from end of calendar year 2026 to FY 2028 in the Oct 2026 call.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: we've committed in Cables & Wires, we will grow at 1.5x of market growth.
items.evidence: The Cables & Wires growth target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.
items.evidence: The medium- to long-term EBIT margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
items.evidence: The FY 2030 EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.
items.evidence: The long-term revenue growth target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Over the medium to long term, we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.
items.evidence: The medium to long-term EPC operating margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.
items.evidence: The 2030 export revenue contribution target is pending.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: As these effects normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
items.evidence: The long-term working capital cycle target is pending.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.
items.evidence: The medium- to long-term EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
items.evidence: The long-term FMEG revenue growth target is pending.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range
items.evidence: The medium- to long-term EPC EBIT margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: I would believe you would appreciate the kind of efforts that we have put together to get this segment turnaround in the way we have been seeing the results in this quarter. So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.
items.evidence: The long-term FMEG EBITDA margin target is pending.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: I would like to take this opportunity to sort of also let the investor community know that in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028
items.evidence: The FY 2028 EHV plant commissioning target is pending.

promises.summary: Management consistently provides long-term strategic targets that remain pending, with only one instance of a timeline adjustment for capital project commissioning.

business.line: Polycab manufactures wires, cables, and consumer electrical products, generating revenue through strong domestic demand, market leadership, and disciplined execution.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.note: Delivered 47% year-on-year revenue growth with strong domestic demand and channel execution.

segments.name: FMEG
segments.note: Continued to strengthen its growth trajectory and recorded its seventh consecutive profitable quarter.

bull.point: Revenue growth accelerated significantly, reaching 52.8% year-on-year in the most recent quarter.
Financial quality is high, with 101% of five-year profits successfully converted into operating cash flow.
bull.basis: 101% of 5-yr profit converted to operating cash

bull.point: The company maintains a robust balance sheet with a very low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02.

bear.point: Management delayed the EHV capacity commissioning timeline from late 2026 to fiscal year 2028.
bear.basis: EHV capacity commissioning moved to FY 2028

bear.point: Numerous long-term strategic targets, including working capital and margin goals, remain pending and unachieved.
bear.basis: Multiple pending targets in Promise Audit

bear.point: Borrowings have trended upward, increasing from 191 crore in 2023 to 272 crore by September 2026.
